title: Mental crisis calm room watch
summary: Creates a low-stimulation safety routine for panic, shock, grief, or agitation.
content: Mental crisis calm room watch is a practical offline routine for mental health support. Move the person away from crowds, arguments, bright lights, rumors, and repeated questions. Use a calm voice, short choices, and grounding facts: name, place, date, and next safe step. Remove obvious hazards without making the person feel trapped. Keep one trusted person nearby instead of a crowd of helpers. Escalate urgently if the person may harm self or others, cannot be kept safe, or has medical symptoms.
